name: Bullwhip
source:
Bullwhip is a gay romance story set in a struggling wrestling federation. Once, it had everyone's attention. Now, it's waiting for someone to turn the world's eyes back on it. Will it be you?

Choose a tag team partner.

Challenge for the titles.

Wrestle your way to love and glory!

[From [url=https://major-minion.itch.io/bullwhip]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Bullwhip》是一部以陷入困境的摔角联盟为舞台的男同性恋爱情故事。它曾经吸引所有人的目光，如今正等待某个人让全世界重新关注它。那个人会是你吗？

选择一位双打搭档。

挑战冠军头衔。

一路摔角，赢得爱情与荣耀！

（来源：[url=https://major-minion.itch.io/bullwhip]itch.io[/url]）
